priceSnapshot.note: THE ADD GATE FIRED. That is the whole report. Morning named one condition - a settled 4H close above 64,630.3 - and the 12:00Z 4H bar settled at 64,860.2, 229.9 points clear of it. The move that produced it was fast and it was mechanical: the 14:00Z 1H bar opened 64,224.5 and printed a high of 65,066.1 inside sixty minutes, an 841.6-point range on a single bar, and the OKX realized-liquidation feed shows exactly why - 739,774 dollars of SHORT liquidations clustered at 65,000 in the newest 48 fills, including a single 1,032-contract fill at 65,000.9. That was the brightest band on the map morning read from CoinGlass. It was tagged, it was cleared, and price has since faded 365 points to 64,701.3. Two structural facts changed with it. FIRST, spot is 339.5 points ABOVE the daily ema50 at 64,361.8 - the level that has capped this market for three consecutive sessions and that morning called 'the whole argument'. SECOND, price is above all four EMAs on 15m, 1H and 4H simultaneously for the first time in the file's recent run. The caution is equally specific: the fuel that produced the move has been spent, 4H RSI is 72.00, and the 15m MACD histogram has already rolled negative at -1.59.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close above $65,066.1 - the 24-hour high and the top of the liquidation spike. The distinction matters: today's 65,000 tag was a wick that harvested resting short stops and gave the level straight back within one bar. A settled close above the wick high would mean the market is holding ground it had to buy fuel to reach, which is a different and much stronger signal. Below that, the 65,000 shelf is now cleared inventory and reads as resistance, not as a magnet.

decisionBox.changed: Bias steps UP from range-with-a-bullish-tilt to BULLISH, and confidence from 6.25 to 6.75. Three things earned it and one thing caps it. FOR: the add gate the desk has published unchanged for four consecutive reports finally settled through, at 64,860.2 against a gate of 64,630.3. The daily ema50 at 64,361.8, overhead for three sessions, is now 339.5 points below spot. Open interest rose a FOURTH consecutive read to $2,113,417,994.95, +0.48% on morning and +$24.4m on midnight, so the move up was accompanied by fresh notional rather than by short covering alone - though the liquidation tape says covering did the last 400 points of it. The 1H MACD histogram has flipped positive at +32.71 from -38.29 at morning. AGAINST, and this is why the position is TAKE_PROFIT and not ADD: the single largest liquidation cluster on the map was ABOVE at 65,000 and it has now been consumed - $829,086 of short liquidations against $36,406 of long liquidations in the newest 48 fills, a 22.8-to-1 skew - which means the specific fuel that carried price through the gate no longer exists. 4H RSI is 72.00, the highest reading in this file's recent run and inside the >75 crypto-overbought warning band. The 15m MACD histogram has already turned negative at -1.59. And funding settled at +0.005213% for the 16:00Z period, the highest of the recent sequence, so longs are paying more than at any point this week. The book is 194 USDT of spot against 4.02 USDT of cash, which is no ammunition at all. So the desk trims 5% of the spot core into the level it named, rebuilds cash toward 14 USDT, and keeps 95% of the position for the trend it now believes in.

calibration.note: The prior report is 2026-08-18-morning, published at 07:05:00-05:00 with spot at 64,335.2. THE ADD GATE FIRED AND THE REDUCE LINE HELD - both calls were right, and the second was closer than it looks. Its reduce line at 64,086.9 required a settled 1H close below it; the 13:00Z bar printed a LOW of 64,047.5, 39.4 points THROUGH the line, and then closed at 64,224.4, 137.5 points back above it. So the level was breached intrabar and defended on the close, which is exactly the distinction the confirmation language was written to make - this is the second consecutive session where the settled-close wording saved the desk from acting on a wick. Its add gate at 64,630.3 required a settled 4H close above it; the 12:00Z 4H bar settled 64,860.2, 229.9 points clear. On the trade: morning bought 3 USDT of spot at 64,335.2, roughly 0.00004663 BTC, and spot marks 366.1 points higher at 64,701.3 - about plus 0.0171 USDT. Small, but a win, and it is graded YES. Three morning claims should be marked. FIRST, morning said the brightest band on the CoinGlass heatmap sat near 65,000 and that a settled break of the gate had a magnet waiting roughly 370 points higher. Price ran to 65,066.1 and the OKX realized-liquidation feed independently confirms $739,774 of short liquidations at that exact handle. That is the single best-verified call in this file's recent history: a level read qualitatively off a screenshot at 07:01 and confirmed quantitatively by a different data source eight hours later. SECOND, morning sized the add at 3 USDT rather than the full 7.02 reserve, explicitly because the daily ema50 was still overhead. That caution cost roughly 0.023 USDT of foregone gain and it was the wrong call in hindsight - the desk should note that its correct level read was undercut by its own sizing. THIRD, morning kept the reduce line at 64,086.9 and warned the nearest band was BELOW at 63,830 while the bigger prize was above; the trip down came first (to 64,047.5) and the trip up came second, which is exactly the geometry it described. The pattern to carry into endday: this desk's level identification is now demonstrably better than its position sizing.
